author: Legoche
body:
Hello, it has come to my attention that one of your STAFF is blatantly cheating.
I would like LFT, Posighdun and Lokigh to NOT be involved in this decision.
I will now compile this conclusive evidence into the thread.

https://youtu.be/-aYT2iltxaE?t=4m47s
Look at his head to start. He is quite clearly headtwitching, although this could be acted out, he headtwitches alot, as you will see in these coming clips.

https://youtu.be/-aYT2iltxaE?t=6m5s 
Look at this clip slowed down. The first hit is clearly out of his reach, it is at least 5 blocks away (since he is jumping) also look at how he catches onto the nearby player. Remember, seuthy was banned for this (https://youtu.be/OsLwME10w1E?t=20s) and Posighdun thought that it was conclusive.

https://youtu.be/35ZSJIpYF6k
This piece of evidence is conclusive on it's own. That is clearly a 5+ block hit, and is not possible at all without cheats. Watch the headtwitch later in the clip also.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJns9369vpI&feature=youtu.be&t=53s
This, again, another headtwitch. Slow this down and look how perfect he follows seuthy's head. The first hit he gets blatantly outreaches seuthy also, same with the last hit.

https://youtu.be/RV-5cFUBzfU
And to finish off, the most blatant clip of them all. I'll let the clip do the talking.
